topic: Analytics data release and model application
summary_markdown:
The primary focus was on releasing updated analytics data, specifically for a facility (ID 3624), comparing conversion rates between live and staging environments. A significant discrepancy in the conversion rate was noted.

Separately, a discussion occurred regarding applying a newly assigned category to historical data within the model. It was confirmed that simply assigning the category is insufficient; the date dimension needs adjustment so the model can recalculate and reaggregate the data for future dates.
decisions: The updated analytics data will be released tomorrow morning after fixing a misaligned footer today.
action_items: Review current conversion rates on the product, prioritizing accurate data over historical trends (UK).
Adjust the date dimension to allow model recalculation when categories are assigned retroactively.
